message: Last winter, I was cozied up on the couch, hot cocoa in hand, when the power flickered and my phone flashed a warning about an incoming storm. I thought, "Great, I’ll check the weather app…and then...nothing. My phone died right when I needed it most!" I ended up digging out my old radio from the attic, which was a bit of a blast from the past. It reminded me that sometimes, good old-fashioned methods are best. Just a little reminder to keep a backup plan handy—like a battery-operated radio or even a good ol’ book! What’s your go-to for staying connected when the tech fails? 📻
